column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT y.`Transaction ID`, y.branch_name as `Branch`, y.product_name as `Product`, y.`Client Account`, y.`Client Name`, y.`Savings Account`, y.`Share Account`, y.`Number of Shares`, y.`Share Unit Price`, y.`Amount`, y.`Charges`, y.`UserName`, y.`Transaction Type`, y.`Transaction Status`, y.`Transaction Date` FROM( select st.id as `Transaction ID`, CONCAT(o.name, '') as branch_name, CONCAT(sp.name, '') as product_name, c.account_no as `Client Account`, o.id as officeId, ur.id as userId, sp.id as shareProductId , c.display_name as `Client Name`, s.account_no as `Savings Account`, sh.account_no as `Share Account`, st.total_shares as `Number of Shares`, st.unit_price as `Share Unit Price`, st.amount_paid as Amount, st.charge_amount as Charges, ur.username as UserName, st.type_enum AS transactionTypeEnum, st.status_enum AS transactionStatusEnum, case st.type_enum when 0 then 'Invalid' when 100 then 'Applied' when 300 then 'Approved' when 400 then 'Rejected' when 500 then 'Purchased' when 600 then 'Redeemed' when 700 then 'ChargePayment' else 'Unknown' end as `Transaction Type`, case st.status_enum when 0 then 'Invalid' when 100 then 'Applied' when 300 then 'Approved' when 400 then 'Rejected' when 500 then 'Purchased' when 600 then 'Redeemed' when 700 then 'ChargePayment' else 'Unknown' end as `Transaction Status`, st.transaction_date as `Transaction Date` from m_share_account_transactions st join m_share_account sh on sh.id = st.account_id join m_savings_account s on s.id = sh.savings_account_id join m_appuser ur on ur.id = sh.submitted_userid join m_client c on c.id = sh.client_id join m_share_product sp on sp.id = sh.product_id join m_office o on o.id = c.office_id )y where (y.officeId = ${officeId} or '-1' = ${officeId} ) and (y.shareProductId = ${shareProductId} or '-1' = ${shareProductId} ) and (y.userId = ${userId} or '-1' = ${userId} ) and (y.transactionTypeEnum = ${transactionType} or '-1' = ${transactionType} ) and (y.transactionStatusEnum = ${transactionStatus} or '-1' = ${transactionStatus} ) and y.`Transaction Date` BETWEEN '${startDate}' AND '${endDate}' order by y.`Client Name`

SELECT y.`Client Name`, y.`Client Number`, y.`Savings Account Number`, y.`Share Account Number`, y.share_product_name AS `Share Product`, y.branch_name AS `Branch`, y.`Date Submitted`, y.`Rejected Date`, y.`Rejected By`, y.`Status`, y.`Rejection Reason` FROM ( SELECT c.account_no AS `Client Number`, c.display_name AS `Client Name`, s.account_no AS `Savings Account Number`, sh.account_no AS `Share Account Number`, sp.id AS shareProductId, CONCAT(sp.name, '') AS share_product_name, o.id AS officeId, CONCAT(o.name, '') AS branch_name, sh.rejected_date AS `Rejected Date`, sh.submitted_date as `Date Submitted`, ur.id as userId, ur.username as `Rejected By`, coalesce(n.note, 'Not Provided') as `Rejection Reason`, CASE sh.status_enum WHEN 100 THEN 'Submitted And Pending Approval' WHEN 200 THEN 'Approved' WHEN 300 THEN 'Active' WHEN 600 THEN 'Closed' WHEN 500 THEN 'Rejected' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS `Status`
FROM m_share_account sh JOIN m_client c ON c.id = sh.client_id JOIN m_savings_account s ON s.id = sh.savings_account_id JOIN m_share_product sp ON sp.id = sh.product_id JOIN m_office o ON o.id = c.office_id JOIN m_appuser ur on ur.id = sh.rejected_userid left JOIN m_note n on n.share_account_id = sh.id where sh.status_enum = 500 ) y where (y.officeId = ${officeId} or '-1' = ${officeId}) and (y.userId = ${userId} or '-1' = ${userId} ) AND (y.shareProductId = ${shareProductId} or '-1' = ${shareProductId}) AND y.`Rejected Date` BETWEEN '${startDate}' AND '${endDate}' ORDER BY y.`Client Name`

column.value: select y.`Rank`, y.`Client Name`, y.`Client Number`, y.`Savings Account Number`, y.`Share Account Number`, y.share_product_name AS `Share Product`, y.branch_name AS `Branch`, y.`Number of Shares`, y.`Total Share Value` FROM ( SELECT CAST( ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY x.`Number of Shares` DESC ) AS SIGNED ) AS `Rank`, x.* FROM( select c.account_no AS `Client Number`, c.display_name AS `Client Name`, s.account_no AS `Savings Account Number`, sh.account_no AS `Share Account Number`, sp.id AS shareProductId, CONCAT(sp.name, '') AS share_product_name, o.id AS officeId, CONCAT(o.name, '') AS branch_name, coalesce(SUM(st.total_shares),0) AS `Number of Shares`, coalesce(SUM(st.amount),0) AS `Total Share Value` FROM m_share_account sh JOIN m_client c ON c.id = sh.client_id JOIN m_savings_account s ON s.id = sh.savings_account_id JOIN m_share_product sp ON sp.id = sh.product_id JOIN m_office o ON o.id = c.office_id JOIN m_share_account_transactions st on sh.id = st.account_id where sh.status_enum = 300 and st.type_enum = 500 and st.status_enum = 300 GROUP by c.id, c.account_no, c.display_name, s.account_no, sh.account_no, sp.id, sp.name, o.id, o.name )x ) y where (y.officeId = ${officeId} or '-1' = ${officeId}) AND (y.shareProductId = ${shareProductId} or '-1' = ${shareProductId}) and (y.`Rank` <= ${topN} or '-1' = ${topN} ) ORDER BY y.`Number of Shares` desc
